Test Case Description: Verify Consignee is classified as B2B when Consignee Name matches a configured B2B keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open http://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management in Chrome.
2. Login as Super Admin using valid test credentials.
3. Wait until the Customs Management home page is fully loaded.
4. From the left navigation menu, click B2B Classification.
5. Download the B2B Keywords template and prepare an Excel row with Keyword matching the test Consignee Name and Match Type = Exact (or as required).
6. Click Browse/Choose File, select the Excel file, and click Upload/Save.
7. Verify upload success message is displayed.
8. Trigger shipment ingestion for a test AWB with Consignee Name exactly matching the configured keyword (InfoAXS feed or standard ingestion flow).
9. Wait until charge creation/classification processing completes.
10. From the left navigation menu, click Custom Search.
11. Apply filter Category = Low Value (LV), Customs Type = DDU, Shipment Business Type = B2B, and Charge Status = Pending Calculation (adjust filters if shipment differs).
12. Enter the test AWB Number in the Tracking Number field and click Search.
13. Click the matching result row to open Charge Detail 360 View.
14. In the Shipment Details / Customs & Goods section, locate Shipment Business Type (or Business Type per build).
15. Verify Shipment Business Type displays B2B.
Expected Result: Shipment is classified as B2B when Consignee Name matches an active B2B keyword.

1. Open http://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management in Chrome.
2. Login as Customs Manager using valid test credentials.
3. From the left navigation menu, click Upload Actuals.
4. Upload Actual for AWB-BOE-DUP with Declaration Number DEC001 on BOE1; confirm success.
5. Upload second Actual for same AWB with Declaration Number DEC001 on BOE2 or duplicate mapping.
6. Observe validation error on second upload.
7. Verify duplicate within same shipment is rejected.
Expected Result: System rejects the second upload and displays duplicate Declaration Number validation.
